name: Commerce Winbank (Redirect)
description: A Winbank (Piraeus Bank) redirect payment gateway for Drupal Commerce. Verifies the callback with an HMAC-SHA256 HashKey.
project_description:
Redirection payment for Drupal Commerce and Winbank. Winbank offers cards and internet services for retail clients of Piraeus Bank (Greece) and is a banking institute with physical points in many areas of the world.

 By using redirection payments your site's customers get redirected to the bank and fill in their credit card data there. Credit card information is NOT stored in Drupal's database. This ensures better security and it costs less because there is no need for expensive compliance certificates on your server.

 Requirements 
 
 Drupal commerce (all versions) 
 static checkout url (7.x only) 
 
 For Drupal 7.x check out admin/commerce/config/static_checkout_url for the links you should provide to the bank for proper communication with your Commerce site.

 For Drupal 8.x and above specific instructions, please see the README file.

 Multilingual 
 The 2.0.x release has a first attempt at restoring the language after returning from winbank redirect. It works but might need improvements. Please test it out report any feedback on [#3131370].

 Drupal 9 compatibility 
 For drupal 9 please download the 2.0.x version. If you are using composer try composer require 'drupal/commerce_winbank_redirect:^2.0' . This branch has started from 2.x release and includes multilingual attempt mentioned above.

 Known problems 
 No problems have been reported if you find something that does not look right please post it on the issue queue.
